summary: Frontend-only testing of Expense Module for Drawlead OS Finance section. All 12 test features PASSED. Dashboard View with summary cards, bank accounts, category breakdown, recent transactions - all working. Table View with columns and IN/OUT badges working. Add Income and Add Expense modals with all fields including Category dropdown. Filter bar with date range and category dropdowns working.
critical_code_review_comments: ExpenseTab.js is well-structured with clear separation of Dashboard and Table views
Proper use of data-testid='expense-tab' for testing
Good use of color coding: green for income, red for expense
Summary cards have proper icons and percentage badges
Bank accounts section shows 4 accounts with clickable cards
Category breakdown has progress bars with proper styling
Modal forms are clean with proper field labels and Cancel/Submit buttons
seed_data_creation: Test data exists: 2 income entries (Veli Shop ₹80,000, TEST_Client_Payment ₹10,000) and 1 expense payment (Salary ₹15,000)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expense Module fully tested. Dashboard-first UX with Dashboard and Table View toggle. Summary cards show Cash In ₹90,000, Cash Out ₹15,000, Balance ₹75,000, Pending ₹0. 4 bank accounts present. Category breakdown shows Salary at 100%. Recent Transactions shows 3 entries. Add Income and Add Expense modals working with all fields. Filter bar working. NO MOCKED APIs.
